title: Student vanishes on mountain excursion in Minas Gerais
place_text: Mountainous region of Minas Gerais, Brazil

tellings.quote: This very well-known event involving a group of students who were on an excursion in the mountainous region of Mina. and one of the girls moved away from the group for a while and just vanished.

plain: A group of students went on an excursion in the mountains of Minas Gerais, a state in Brazil, and one of the girls wandered away from the group for a while and simply vanished. Aldo Rebelo, who is presented on the show as a Brazilian defense minister, calls it a very well-known event and says it was reported in the local press. He brings it up as one of the strange Brazilian cases that would point to something unexplained if it happened as described.
